notice: EXAMPLE CONFIGURATION - NOT A REVIEWED SETTLEMENT SPEC. verification.status is UNVERIFIED and no reviewer is named, so this spec blocks model-dependent strategy activation (handoff section 9.2, WP-110 acceptance 3). VENUE-SETL-1 redrafted the values below on 2026-10-04 from public evidence recorded in docs/settlement/btc-15m-updown-review.md: the market rules text (sha256 485ceb1dabc4aa12fb42c76184563b7378f01e5de9ded73df049c0d191cd5ad1, byte-identical on all 31 btc-up-or-down-15m windows read that open at or after 2026-08-07T00:00Z), the official Polymarket changelog entries of 2026-08-07 and 2026-08-14, the Polymarket PolyBolt TWAP channel reference, and the Chainlink Data Streams TWAP documentation. No human has reviewed them. Before this spec may be marked reviewed, a person must answer every line of docs/settlement/btc-15m-updown-review-checklist.md, a rules version must exist to name (no catalog rules-version row exists for these markets yet), and the window must be confirmed against the windows the feed publishes at that time.

settlementSpec.resolutionSource: Chainlink Data Streams BTC/USD 60-second TWAP stream: the market rules text names the BTC/USD TWAP data stream at https://data.chain.link/streams/btc-usd-twap-60s-streams. Polymarket documents its 60-second Chainlink TWAP series as the prices used by crypto up/down market resolution (PolyBolt channel price.crypto.twap, which requires CLOB API credentials).
settlementSpec.windowStartRule: Sixty seconds before the window end instant. The settlement value is a 60-second TWAP, and Chainlink states that a 60-second TWAP at instant T covers T minus 60 seconds through T. Polymarket does not document whether this start boundary is inclusive.
settlementSpec.windowEndRule: The market close instant: Gamma endDate, which equals eventStartTime plus 900 seconds and the end of the ET range in the title. The settlement value is the stream's 60-second TWAP at that instant. Chainlink's rule for an instant at which no report ends is that the report whose window contains the instant applies; Polymarket does not document which report it reads at the close.
settlementSpec.referenceOpenSource: The same 60-second TWAP stream's value at the market open instant (Gamma eventStartTime, the start of the ET range in the title), that is, the TWAP over the 60 seconds ending at the open. Polymarket calls it the price to beat, and its 2026-08-07 changelog states that both the price to beat and the final settlement price come from the applicable TWAP feed.
settlementSpec.timestampBoundary: All instants are UTC. The market window opens at Gamma eventStartTime and closes at Gamma endDate, 900 seconds later; the ET range in the title is the same interval in America/New_York time (UTC-4 until 2026-11-01, UTC-5 after). Gamma startDate is the market creation time, about 24 hours before the open, and is not the window open. The opening value is read at the open instant and the settlement value at the close instant; Polymarket does not document whether either instant is inclusive.
settlementSpec.roundingRule: No rounding: the settlement value and the opening value are compared as exact decimals at the precision the stream publishes. Polymarket does not document the precision of its comparison; the eventMetadata priceToBeat and finalPrice numbers it publishes are binary floating-point values and are never used for settlement here.
settlementSpec.fallbackSource: None. If the stream value at either instant is unavailable or ambiguous, halt entries for the series and escalate to the operator; no substitute source is used and no value is interpolated. Polymarket documents no fallback source for this series.
settlementSpec.disputePolicy: Halt entries for the market, keep the position observable, and settle nothing while a dispute is open; a dispute is an in-flight process, not an outcome. Windows of this series were observed to resolve automatically about one minute after the close; whether, and for how long, such a resolution can be disputed is not documented.
settlementSpec.clarificationPolicy: On any post-open clarification, whether an Additional context update or any change to the rules text or its sha256, halt entries for the series and require a fresh human review of this spec against the amended rules before the series resumes.
